name: the-app-declares-one-window-not-a-group
breaks: SwiftUI answers every incoming postroll:// URL by opening a NEW window, so the count grows by one per link and survives a quit through window restoration. Worse, showingNewEvent is one flag on the shared AppState and every window binds a sheet to it, so one link puts up a New Event sheet on each window with the same prefill and cancelling one leaves the others standing. Measured on the real machine at 1, then 2, then 3 (#842)
